message: Nathan, we're doing a small builder's dinner in SF with folks working on the next wave of infra—Louan from UCSF and Artem from Osmosis are coming, among others. Your conviction that world models will displace LLM-only architectures for robotics is exactly the kind of thinking we want in the room, especially as most of these folks are deep in the developer-tools and ML-infra layer. Want in?
